  <p class="intro-text">
  Climate Gazette features stories of extreme weather events that occurred in Europe over the past 40 years. 
  Reports are based on data from the <a href="https://climateindex.eu" target="_blank">European Extreme Events Climate Index</a>, analysed with Jupyter and presented via charts and maps.
  </p>
